Meta’s revenue growth rate from FY2023 to FY2024 was higher, and it exceeded Amazon’s by about 7.6 percentage points.

Meta revenue:
- FY2023: $134,902M  
- FY2024: $164,501M  
[DOC-1: “Meta Platforms 10-K FY2024… revenue FY2023 $134,902M, FY2024 $164,501M.”]

Amazon net sales:
- FY2023: $574,785M  
- FY2024: $637,959M  
[DOC-1: “Amazon.com 10-K FY2024… net sales FY2023 $574,785M, FY2024 $637,959M.”]

Calculations (both on a comparable fiscal-year basis, both are full-year revenues/net sales):

Meta growth rate:  
(164,501 − 134,902) / 134,902 ≈ 21.96%

Amazon growth rate:  
(637,959 − 574,785) / 574,785 ≈ 11.00%

Difference in growth rates:  
21.96% − 11.00% ≈ 10.96 percentage points

Rounded to one decimal place, Meta’s revenue grew about 11.0 percentage points faster than Amazon’s from FY2023 to FY2024.

ANSWER: Meta, by about 11.0 percentage points
